title: Description list
description: Enhances a <dl>: vertical or horizontal layout, borders, striping and spacing.

variant.description: vertical stacks each term over its description; horizontal puts them side by side.

bordered.description: Draw a border around the list. Bare attribute.

striped.description: Shade every other row. Applies to the horizontal variant. Bare attribute.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
